subject: PPAP target configuration requirements clarification
purpose: Record user-confirmed decisions for the future target technical specification; preserve the OOTB baseline separately.

decisions.topic: First release scope
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Core PPAP with those extensions deferred (Recommended)
included: PPAP-side connections to PCR and inspections
constraints: Preserve existing APQP behavior when changing shared components.
Treat connected-application connections as PPAP-side interfaces; do not infer authorization to implement entire connected applications.
Operational BOMEX/ECS integration timing is governed by PPAP-INT-001.

decisions.topic: Operational BOMEX/ECS intake for the first release
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Automated intake in the first release, with controlled manual initiation as a fallback (Recommended)
requirements: Automatically receive applicable BOMEX/ECS changes in the first PPAP release.
Create source-linked initial drawing-review records from the automated intake.
Support controlled manual initiation as a fallback.
constraints: Preserve the existing Product Integration application's isolated business-object boundary.
Define the operational connection needed for PPAP separately; do not assume that isolated intake already supplies operational PPAP relationships or triggers.
Detailed payload mappings, manual-initiation permissions, and fallback reconciliation remain design or subsequent clarification work.

decisions.topic: Manufacturing facility and shipping depot scope
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: One manufacturing facility, with shipping depots linked separately (Recommended)
requirements: Scope each PPAP approval to one manufacturing facility.
Link shipping depots separately as context for the PPAP and its task routing.
constraints: A shipping depot does not replace the manufacturing facility as the approval scope.
Do not require a separate PPAP solely because the same manufacturing facility uses a different linked shipping depot.
Preserve the governed SRM supplier-entity and role-resolution rules when implementing depot links and task routing.

decisions.topic: Governing model and manufacturing-stage context
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: One model/program and one manufacturing stage per model-change PPAP (Recommended)
requirements: Each model-change PPAP has one governing model/program and one manufacturing stage.
Calculate model-change task dates from that governing context using the model schedule and applicable element offsets.
constraints: Do not assign several independently governing model/stage schedules to a single model-change PPAP.
Running-change and process-change PPAPs remain independently scheduled unless explicitly connected to a model-change context under ADR-101.

decisions.topic: Interim and conditional approval
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Full approval only; omit Interim Approval (Recommended)
requirements: Require full PPAP approval; do not provide interim or conditional approval.
Omit the OOTB Interim Approval stage and its entry and exit actions from the target PPAP workflow.
constraints: Reconcile PPAP-specific interim-approval fields, phase values, progress calculations, views, notifications, reports, and other dependencies in the target change specification.
Preserve the separately retained OOTB baseline and existing APQP behavior.

decisions.topic: Cancellation of an issued PPAP
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Engineer or PPAP administrator may cancel, using those controls (Recommended)
requirements: The responsible PPAP engineer or a designated PPAP administrator may cancel an issued PPAP.
Require a cancellation reason and retain the actor and cancellation time.
Stop outstanding PPAP element work and reminders when cancellation completes.
Preserve the PPAP's evidence and complete decision history.
Expose the cancelled PPAP outcome to linked PCR/APQP work and flag it for the responsible owner's resolution; do not treat cancellation as successful fulfilment.
constraints: Do not require a separate cancellation-approval workflow.
Do not automatically cancel an entire originating PCR or APQP solely because a linked PPAP was cancelled.
Approval withdrawal after final closure is outside the first release under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-003.
Eligibility of previously approved elements from cancelled PPAPs is governed by PPAP-EVIDENCE-002.

decisions.topic: Withdrawal of approval after closure
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Do not support approval withdrawal in the first release
requirements: Exclude post-approval withdrawal functionality from the first PPAP release.
constraints: Do not introduce a first-release approval-withdrawal action, workflow, or withdrawal-driven certificate-verification state.
Preserve the original approved package and evidence unchanged.
Cancellation of issued work under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002 does not authorize cancelling an approved, closed PPAP.
Continue to create a new PPAP for applicable engineering changes received after closure, as governed by ADR-104.

decisions.topic: Compatibility and version selection for evidence reuse
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Same facility/drawing/element, with engineer-confirmed revision and part compatibility (Recommended)
requirements: Restrict evidence reuse to the same manufacturing facility, drawing, and governed element type.
Require the responsible engineer to confirm that retained evidence is suitable for the receiving PPAP's drawing revision and selected part scope.
Suggest the latest eligible approved evidence version.
Permit the engineer to select a different eligible approved version with a mandatory reason.
constraints: Do not require an identical drawing revision or identical selected part set when the engineer confirms compatibility.
Do not support cross-facility or cross-drawing reuse under this policy.
Copy retained evidence into the receiving PPAP's immutable task-level snapshot while preserving source lineage under ADR-023.
Cancellation effects on evidence eligibility are governed by PPAP-EVIDENCE-002; element-reopening effects are governed by PPAP-EVIDENCE-003.

decisions.topic: Evidence eligibility after source PPAP cancellation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Exclude approved evidence from cancelled PPAPs from future reuse (Recommended)
requirements: Exclude evidence whose source PPAP is cancelled from future reuse, even when that element was individually approved before cancellation.
Apply the exclusion to both automatic suggestions and manual selection of retained evidence.
Collect and approve a fresh submission in the receiving PPAP when no eligible prior evidence is available.
Preserve existing historical snapshots and source lineage.
constraints: Do not introduce an administrator-revalidation exception to the cancelled-source exclusion in the first release.
The prospective reuse restriction does not authorize deletion or alteration of historical evidence or withdrawal of a closed PPAP approval.

decisions.topic: Evidence eligibility while an approved element is reopened
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Keep the last approved snapshot eligible, subject to compatibility checks (Recommended)
requirements: When an approved element is reopened for an engineering change while its PPAP remains open, retain its last approved evidence snapshot as eligible for reuse elsewhere.
Apply the manufacturing-facility, drawing, element-type, revision, and selected-part compatibility rules in PPAP-EVIDENCE-001.
Make a replacement submission eligible for reuse only after that replacement is approved.
constraints: Reopening an element does not erase or alter its prior approved snapshot or approval history.
The cancelled-source exclusion in PPAP-EVIDENCE-002 continues to apply and takes precedence if the source PPAP is cancelled.
Selection of an eligible approved version other than the suggested latest version continues to require a reason under PPAP-EVIDENCE-001.

decisions.topic: Draft visibility, issue, and supplier scope confirmation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Internal drafts; explicit issue; supplier confirms scope before its first element submission (Recommended)
requirements: Keep draft PPAPs internal and unavailable to supplier users.
Require an explicit engineer issue action before releasing the PPAP to the supplier.
Require the supplier to confirm the manufacturing facility, drawing, and included part numbers before its first supplier element submission.
constraints: Apply ordinary supplier-entity and record-classification security after issue; issue does not grant access outside authorized scope.
The supplier confirmation requirement governs supplier element submissions and does not prevent authorized internal element work.
Post-issue scope is locked under PPAP-SCOPE-003; scope changes require cancellation and replacement.

decisions.topic: Scope immutability after issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Lock facility, drawing number, and part scope; cancel and replace the PPAP if scope changes
requirements: Lock the manufacturing facility, drawing number, and included part-number scope after the PPAP is issued.
Require cancellation of the issued PPAP and creation of a replacement PPAP when any of those scope values must change.
constraints: Do not provide a post-issue part-scope amendment action, including an administrator override, in the first release.

Distinguish drawing number from drawing revision: supplemental engineering changes and drawing-revision updates may continue within an open PPAP under ADR-104 without changing the locked facility, drawing number, or included part set.
Apply cancellation controls under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002 and draft/issue/supplier-confirmation controls under PPAP-RELEASE-001 to the replacement process.
Apply the cancelled-source evidence exclusion under PPAP-EVIDENCE-002; replacement does not make evidence from the cancelled PPAP eligible for retained reuse.

decisions.topic: Authority for safety, quality, and regulated classifications
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Imported drawing/part classifications are authoritative; no PPAP-level overrides (Recommended)
requirements: Use the authoritative drawing/part classifications supplied through operational integration for important-safety, important-quality, and regulated requirements.
Do not permit PPAP-level classification overrides.
Block issue until missing or conflicting classifications are resolved.
constraints: Do not interpret a missing classification as an explicit confirmation that no classification applies.
Resolve classification corrections through the authoritative source and operational integration rather than an override on the PPAP.
Mixed-part aggregation is governed by PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-002; post-issue classification changes are governed by PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-003.

decisions.topic: Aggregation of classifications across included parts
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Combine applicable requirements; any important-safety part triggers management approval (Recommended)
requirements: Combine all applicable evidence requirements arising from the classifications of the included parts.
Require overall management approval whenever at least one included part has the important-safety classification.
constraints: Important-quality or regulated classifications alone affect evidence requirements and do not independently activate overall management approval.
Do not require separate PPAPs solely because the included parts have different classifications.
Use authoritative imported classifications without PPAP-level overrides under PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-001.

decisions.topic: Authoritative classification changes after issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Cancel and replace the issued PPAP when classifications change
requirements: Require cancellation and replacement of an issued, open PPAP when its applicable authoritative classifications change.
Initialize the replacement PPAP using the current authoritative classifications and their combined evidence and approval requirements.
constraints: Do not implement in-place post-issue classification reassessment as an alternative to cancellation and replacement.
Draft preparation may incorporate updated source classifications before issue; no cancellation is required solely to refresh an unissued draft.
Preserve previously closed approvals unchanged; post-approval withdrawal remains outside the first release.
Apply cancellation and replacement controls under PPAP-LIFECYCLE-002 and PPAP-RELEASE-001, including the cancelled-source evidence exclusion under PPAP-EVIDENCE-002.

decisions.topic: Authority for the requirement library and template matrix
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Use SIA's current IntelliQuest library/procedure as the authority; map and reconcile OOTB content (Recommended)
requirements: Use SIA's current IntelliQuest requirement library and PPAP procedure as the authoritative source for the initial target requirement library and template matrix.
Map and reconcile the OOTB elements, checklist content, level templates, routing, and classification defaults against that authoritative source.
constraints: Do not treat the OOTB catalogue as the authority when it differs from the current controlled SIA requirements.
Preserve source traceability for retained, modified, added, or retired OOTB configuration.

required_inputs.description: Current controlled SIA PPAP procedure, IntelliQuest requirement library, and applicable template/classification matrix.
required_inputs.user_answer: Record the source material as pending and continue
required_inputs.handling: Continue clarifying business rules; retain this input as outstanding for source-backed catalogue and template reconciliation.

decisions.topic: Requirement exclusions and protected applicability
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Engineer may exclude unprotected requirements with a reason; protected requirements remain mandatory (Recommended)
requirements: Permit the responsible engineer to mark an unprotected default requirement Not Required during PPAP setup, with a mandatory reason.
Keep requirements mandated by the controlled SIA procedure or applicable classifications protected from waiver.
Allow suppliers to request N/A for engineer review; suppliers cannot waive requirements themselves.
constraints: Do not require a separate administrator-approval workflow for an engineer's permitted exclusion of an unprotected requirement.
Determine the actual protected requirement set through the source-backed reconciliation under PPAP-REQUIREMENTS-001; PPAP-INPUT-001 remains outstanding.
Post-issue element and applicability changes are governed by PPAP-REQUIREMENTS-003 and require cancellation and replacement.

decisions.topic: Requirement-set immutability after issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Lock the requirement set at issue; cancel and replace for additions or exclusions
requirements: Lock the PPAP requirement set and element applicability when the PPAP is issued.
Require cancellation and replacement of an issued PPAP when an element must be added or excluded, including changing an existing element to Not Required.
constraints: Do not provide an in-place post-issue requirement-set amendment action.

Continue to allow correction, resubmission, and authorized reopening of existing required elements for in-flight engineering changes when the locked scope, classifications, and requirement set remain unchanged.
Evaluate a supplier's N/A request through the engineer: an accepted request that changes issued applicability requires cancellation and replacement rather than an in-place waiver.
Apply PPAP-SCOPE-003, PPAP-CLASSIFICATION-003, and the cancellation/release/evidence-reuse controls when deciding whether an in-flight change can remain within the existing PPAP.

decisions.topic: Part-level mass data and validation
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Require both masses for every part, in kg, using those validation rules (Recommended)
requirements: Require average actual mass and average metal mass for every included part before final submission.
Capture both values in kilograms.
Validate average actual mass as greater than zero.
Validate average metal mass as greater than or equal to zero and less than or equal to average actual mass.
Treat zero average metal mass as an explicit confirmation that the part has no metal content.
constraints: Keep unknown mass values missing; do not default unknown values to zero.
Do not permit N/A to bypass either required mass value for an included part.
The final mass-data gate is separate from the scope confirmation required before the first supplier element submission under PPAP-RELEASE-001.

decisions.topic: Calendar basis and initial drawing-review target
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Calendar days; initial drawing review due after 14 calendar days (Recommended)
requirements: Use calendar-day arithmetic for PPAP task-date offsets in the first release.
Set the initial drawing-review target to 14 calendar days after drawing release.
constraints: Do not apply working-day or holiday-calendar adjustments to these first-release calculations.
Keep date-change audit, PPAP schedule disconnection/reconnection, and overdue-date warnings under ADR-101 and ADR-108.

decisions.topic: Date recalculation and preservation of issued baselines
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Update open connected work only; preserve issued baselines and completed history (Recommended)
requirements: Apply model-driven effective due-date recalculation only to open work on schedule-connected PPAPs.
Preserve the original issued planned-date baseline when model schedules subsequently change.
Preserve completed task and closed PPAP date history unchanged.
Keep manually assigned dates on disconnected PPAPs unchanged until an authorized reconnection.
constraints: Do not overwrite an original issued baseline with the latest model plan.
Continue to audit effective date changes and warn before schedule disconnection/reconnection under ADR-101 and ADR-108.
Timeliness and scorecard date-basis rules remain a separate clarification.

decisions.topic: Element due-date completeness before issue
decisions.source: User reply in the PPAP requirements clarification conversation
decisions.user_answer: Require due dates for all required elements before issue, and allow already-overdue dates with a warning.
requirements: Require every required PPAP element to have a calculated or manually assigned due date before issue.
Permit issue when one or more required element due dates are already overdue, while displaying a warning.
constraints: Block issue for missing required element dates, not merely because a populated date is in the past.
Apply the date-completeness gate to both supplier-facing and internal required elements.
Preserve the calendar-day and issued-baseline rules under PPAP-SCHEDULE-002 and PPAP-SCHEDULE-003.
